evidenceKind: offline deterministic simulated preview; not live market observations

generation.timeConvention: All timestamps UTC; preview calls use fixed future simulation instants.
generation.normalization: Each episode: OHLC / its shock-hour opening price * 100. Sequence: OHLC / first hourly open * 100.

ordinaryWickComparison.comparison: Same new profile and cycles, wickBoostFrom enabled versus absent. Completed ordinary 5m candles in the first 24-hour preview only.
ordinaryWickComparison.metric: (upper shadow + lower shadow) / open * 100; arithmetic mean across the sample
